skill.name: docusign-automation
skill.description: Automate DocuSign template, envelope, signature, and status workflows through Rube MCP with current tool schema lookup.
skill.summary: Guides DocuSign template, envelope, sending, and status workflows through Rube MCP.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most external command findings are false positives from Markdown backticks and fenced examples in SKILL.md. The Rube MCP URL is a real low-severity network dependency, and semantic review found third-party access and send-approval risks. The system reconnaissance finding is a false positive because it only validates recipient email addresses.

remediation.suggestion: Warn users to connect only approved Rube MCP servers and review OAuth scopes before authorizing DocuSign access.
Default examples to draft creation and require explicit user approval before setting status to sent or calling DOCUSIGN_SEND_ENVELOPE.
Document how users should verify the MCP endpoint owner, organization policy, and data handling before adding the server.

static_findings.snippet: - Active DocuSign connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `docusign`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
- Response includes template `templateId`, `name`, `description`, roles, and fields
- `emailSubject`: Custom subject line for the signing email
- `emailBlurb`: Custom message in the signing email
- `templateRoles` must match the role names defined in the template exactly (case-sensitive)
- Setting `status` to 'sent' during creation sends immediately; use 'created' for drafts
- Each role requires at minimum `roleName`, `name`, and `email`
- `emailSubject` overrides the template's default email subject
1. `DOCUSIGN_GET_ENVELOPE` - Verify envelope exists and is in draft state [Prerequisite]
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
- All required recipients must have valid email addresses before sending

content.value_statement: DocuSign workflows are slow when teams must find templates, map roles, and track envelope status. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through repeatable Rube MCP workflows.
actual_capabilities: Guides setup checks for Rube MCP and an active DocuSign connection.
Lists DocuSign tools for templates, envelopes, sending, and status monitoring.
Explains template role mapping for signer names, email addresses, and role names.
Describes envelope lifecycle states from draft creation through completion or voiding.
Calls out pitfalls for GUIDs, rate limits, pagination, and nested responses.
limitations: Requires Rube MCP availability and an active DocuSign connection.
Does not include direct DocuSign API code, credentials, or custom scripts.
Cannot verify account permissions, templates, or recipients until tools run.
Sending envelopes can have legal effects and needs explicit user approval.

use_cases.title: Send Standard Agreements
use_cases.description: Find approved templates, map signer roles, and prepare draft envelopes for repeatable agreement workflows.

use_cases.title: Track Signature Progress
use_cases.description: Check envelope status, recipient progress, and completion dates without manually browsing DocuSign.

use_cases.title: Validate Template Setup
use_cases.description: Review template roles, required recipients, and identifier mapping before launching a signing process.

prompt_templates.title: List Available Templates
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the DocuSign automation skill to list available templates. Ask for filters only if needed. Summarize template names, roles, and IDs.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Draft Envelope
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the skill to create a draft envelope from [template name]. Resolve the template ID first. Ask for missing signer names or emails.

prompt_templates.title: Track Signing Progress
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the skill to check envelope [envelope ID]. Report overall status, recipient status, dates, and the next needed action.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Controlled Send
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the skill to prepare a template-based send for [business process]. Create a draft first. Verify recipients and email text, then ask for approval.

output_examples.input: Find the NDA template and tell me which signer roles it needs.
output_examples.output: The assistant lists matching templates, identifies the NDA template ID, and summarizes required signer roles for review.

output_examples.input: Create a draft sales agreement envelope for Alex Rivera and Jordan Lee.
output_examples.output: The assistant resolves the template, maps each role to a recipient, creates a draft, and reports the envelope ID.

output_examples.input: Check the status of envelope 1234 and tell me who still needs to sign.
output_examples.output: The assistant reports the envelope state, each recipient status, key dates, and the next follow-up action.

best_practices: Confirm account access, template choice, recipient names, and email addresses before creating envelopes.
Create drafts first when recipient data, roles, or email messages need review.
Poll status at reasonable intervals and respect DocuSign account rate limits.
anti_patterns: Sending immediately before verifying recipient names, email addresses, and role mappings.
Hardcoding template or envelope IDs across different DocuSign accounts.
Treating delivered status as signed or completed status.

faq.question: Does this skill send documents by itself?
faq.answer: No. It guides the AI through DocuSign tools. Users should approve every send action before it runs.

faq.question: What connection is required?
faq.answer: It requires Rube MCP and an active DocuSign connection through the docusign toolkit.

faq.question: Can it create envelopes from templates?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains how to find templates, map roles, create drafts, and send envelopes.

faq.question: Can it monitor signing progress?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses envelope lookup to report status, recipient progress, and completion dates.

faq.question: Does it include DocuSign API credentials?
faq.answer: No. The skill does not contain credentials. Authentication happens through the connected Rube MCP workflow.

faq.question: What should users verify before sending?
faq.answer: Verify the template, signer names, email addresses, role mapping, message text, and account permissions.
